name: In-situ oxygen liquefaction/zero-boil-off in a prototype lander tank with a 90 K reverse-turbo-Brayton cryocooler (CryoFILL)
plain_name: Make and keep liquid oxygen in a Moon-lander tank using an electric cryogenic cooler
description: NASA GRC CryoFILL third test: a Creare 150 W / 90 K reverse turbo-Brayton cryocooler integrated with a prototype lander LOX tank in the SMiRF vacuum chamber, chilled down with the tank 90% full of LOX and operated for 31 days in steady and cyclic modes.
keywords: Make and keep liquid oxygen in a Moon-lander tank using an electric cryogenic cooler

sources.citation: Extended Duration Testing of a 90 K Cryocooler for Space Applications (Johnson et al., NASA GRC, ICC 24, 2026)

reported_equipment: Creare 90 K cryocooler (150W/90K Reverse Turbo Brayton)
NASA GRC SMiRF Facility vacuum chamber

requirements.rationale: The cooler operates at a 90 K design point to liquefy and hold oxygen.
The tank under test holds liquid oxygen.
The prototype tank is tested inside the SMiRF vacuum chamber.
Optional: the integrated test ran 31 days (744 h).

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
